title: Fleet Reaper Phase 2 — leftover-bash classifier + soft RAM relief + GPU/Ollama coordinator + alpha-slot guardian
description: Strictly additive over FLEET-REAPER-MS0. Three new layers in fleet-reaper-sweep.mjs (soft RAM/CPU relief, GPU/Ollama probe, Ollama coordinator) + a new leftover-bash-task candidate class in process-slot-map.mjs + a TTL'd routing-hint consumer in ollama-task-offloader.mjs + the alpha-slot-reaper-guardian hook that pins reaper-ownership to the alpha chat. Reframes the reaper from 'kill more orphans' to 'use what's idle' — the box runs near the commit-memory ceiling while the GPU sits at single-digit utilization; convert idle GPU VRAM + idle stale-slot RAM into 6-chat throughput, soft-first (reversible), kill-last.
goals: Catch the orphan class FLEET-REAPER-MS0 missed: a Bash-tool Monitor loop whose chat died but whose claude.exe lingered alive but unpinned
Convert idle GPU VRAM into commit-memory relief via an Ollama pre-warm + routing hint that lowers ollama-task-offloader's offload bar under pressure
Apply reversible soft relief (priority + working-set trim) to stale-slot processes BEFORE the 10-min crashed-slot threshold escalates to a kill
Pin reaper-ownership to the alpha chat via a SessionStart+UserPromptSubmit hook so the durable scheduled task stays registered + enabled

phases.title: Phase 2 — three layers + a new candidate class + the alpha-slot guardian
phases.intent: After this phase: the leftover-bash-task class is wired into classifyProcess; soft RAM/CPU relief acts on stale-slot processes; the GPU + Ollama probe + coordinator are integrated into runSweep; the routing-hint contract is established (producer: fleet-reaper-sweep; consumer: ollama-task-offloader); the alpha-slot guardian is wired into both SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit; all docs (CLAUDE.md + wiki + 4 tribal tips + 2 memory entries) are doc-synced; the 137-case vitest suite is green.

criteria: All 6 units shipped + per-file 2-reviewer scrutiny PASS on every file
Full 137-case fleet-reaper.test.mjs vitest suite green (was 66; +71 new cases)
Vite-transform follow-up #1 closed (was blocking the helper test suite — fixed by removing vestigial shebangs + clampInt null-handling guard)
CLAUDE.md + knowledge/wiki/architecture/fleet-reaper.md Phase 2 section + 3 new wiki entries + 4 tribal tips + 2 memory entries all landed
HOOK_REGISTRY.json regenerated; alpha-slot-reaper-guardian.mjs registered as wired (SessionStart + UserPromptSubmit, timeout 10000)

U-PHASE2-BASH-CLASSIFIER.description: New leftover-bash-task candidate class: bash/sh + structural cmd-pattern (AND-of-simple-regexes, 4096-char truncation = ReDoS-safe) + age >= 15 min + UNPINNED claude.exe ancestor + resolved slot data. __slotsResolved flag threaded through snapshotFleet — degraded slot data never widens the candidate set.

U-PHASE2-SOFT-RELIEF.description: Layer 1 — reversible RAM/CPU relief on stale-slot processes only: BelowNormal priority + working-set trim (.NET EmptyWorkingSet). Age floor 180s. Audit -> dedicated state/shared/.fleet-reaper-actions.jsonl.

U-PHASE2-GPU-PROBE.description: Layer 2 — readGpuState (nvidia-smi CSV, fail-soft) + readOllamaState (/api/tags + /api/ps, honors OLLAMA_URL).

U-PHASE2-OLLAMA-COORD.description: Layer 3 — decideOllamaCoordination (pure truth table) + prewarmOllama (fire-and-forget) + writeRoutingHint (atomic, TTL'd, neutralizes a stale aggressive hint to mode:auto).

U-PHASE2-HINT-CONSUMER.description: loadRoutingHint reads state/shared/.ollama-routing-hint.json (fixed absolute literal — cross-process contract), applies thresholdDelta clamped to +/-0.30 so more hook-eligible work clears for Ollama.

U-PHASE2-ALPHA-GUARDIAN.description: SessionStart + UserPromptSubmit hook. For the alpha chat: ensures the PRISM Fleet Reaper scheduled task is registered + enabled, kicks a throttled detached --once sweep, emits a LOUD advisory on missing/disabled. Every other chat is a silent no-op. Stamp-throttled even under PRISM_ALPHA_GUARDIAN_NO_SWEEP=1. Both per-file reviewers PASS.

follow_ups.title: vitest helper-suite blocked by vite-transform bug
follow_ups.note: Vite's SSR transform did not strip a line-1 shebang and stranded it mid-file. Removed vestigial shebangs from 3 files + fixed a clampInt null-handling bug surfaced by the now-running tests. Full 137-case suite green.

follow_ups.title: Coordinator gating behavior — observed 'below pressure floor' at 98.7% commit
follow_ups.note: decideOllamaCoordination gates on mem.usedPct = max(physUsedPct, commitUsedPct). The observed silent-at-98.7%-commit may be a denominator question (TotalVirtualMemorySize) — or it may be resolved by the clampInt fix (was clamping the pressure gate to 1%). Re-observe post-fix to confirm.
